Week-one item of #221, and **time-critical in a way the others are not**: it must complete **before any foreign lane lands its first issue**.

ADR-0061 Decision 6 admits a profile to a seat when its own gate record over N issues clears a bar **pre-registered before that lane's numbers are seen**. Pre-registration is the load-bearing word. The historical baseline is confounded by task mix and by process changes over the period; seeing the new lane's numbers first turns that confounding into a licence to move the bar. Once a z.ai dispatch has landed anything, this issue can no longer be done honestly.

## What

Derive the bar from the Claude history already in the repo — free, no new spend on the scarce pool, no control arm, no discarded work.

Candidate signals, all of which the project already produces per issue:

- gate cycles to first green, and red runs before green
- corpus verdict class and count
- review findings raised against the issue afterwards
- rework commits in the following week
- wall clock, and quota consumed

## Method notes

- The denominator matters. Roughly 168 issue closes in 7 days and 150 commits in 4 days are on record, but not every close is a dispatched implementation issue with a gate signal — batch small-fry, docs and retro amendments inflate that count. Separate them, and state the eligible population you actually used.
- Report the distribution, not just a mean. A bar set at the mean admits a lane that is worse than half of historical Claude work.
- Set the bar **per seat**, since implementer, mechanical and recon work have different gate profiles.
- State N — how many issues a profile must run before admission is decided. Too small and admission is noise; too large and the freeze holds longer than it needs to.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The eligible historical population is defined and its size stated
- [ ] A bar per seat, with the distribution behind it, not a single number
- [ ] N stated, with the reasoning for that value
- [ ] Recorded in the issue **before** any foreign-lane dispatch lands, with the timestamp visible
- [ ] Human sign-off, since this is the threshold that lifts the WIP freeze

Refs #221, ADR-0061
